page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 32 physical cores and 32 vCPUs, utilizing a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, featuring 94,489 GB of local HDD storage. This high-density storage configuration is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The hypervisor layer is managed via KVM, and no GPU accelerators are included in this hardware profile.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is its reliance on traditional HDD storage rather than solid-state drives, which limits random IOPS performance but offers massive capacity. This makes the instance highly cost-efficient for workloads requiring vast storage volume without the need for ultra-low latency SSDs. Appropriate workloads include large-scale data warehousing, log processing, distributed file systems like HDFS, and cold data storage.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is a storage-focused x86_64 server instance designed for high-capacity data workloads. It is powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor operating at 2.5 GHz, delivering 32 physical cores and 32 vCPUs with a single thread per core. The system is configured with 128.0 GB of RAM, establishing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. A key feature of this instance is its massive 94,489 GB of local HDD storage, supported by a 20 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Because it utilizes HDD storage instead of SSDs, it presents a clear tradeoff: lower random read/write performance in exchange for exceptional storage density and qualitative cost efficiency for bulk data. This instance is best suited for distributed file systems, large-scale log archiving, data warehousing, and cold storage applications.
